cold_app_ready_p95_ms.reason: Thirty process launches used warm filesystem caches and a headless draw; OS-presented cold readiness was not instrumented.

idle_product_rss_mib.aggregation: maximum observed resident process RSS sum

physical_keyboard_to_render_p95_ms.reason: API send-to-capture and headless draw timings exclude physical keyboard dispatch and display presentation.

ten_minute_output_bounded_rss.reason: A finite 600-second window was measured. The current contract gives no output-load RSS bound or steady-state threshold; no general bound is claimed.

user_zsh_configuration_cost.reason: Only an owned minimal prompt was loaded. User shell configuration was not accessed.

warm_attach_p95_ms.reason: In-process native warm attachment was not timed separately.

limitations: Native readiness includes headless drawing, not macOS presentation or physical keyboard latency.
CPU covers resident owned product processes; short-lived helpers between samples are not included.
Shells and workload processes are excluded. RSS is the sum of resident process RSS, including shared pages.
Process launches use warm filesystem caches; no privileged cache purge is performed.
Host background load is not controlled; concurrent work may affect wall-clock latency.
create_ms includes actions.perform layout-split transactions after the first session.

optimization_delta.reason: The earlier five-round backend-only short baseline is not comparable to the final thirty-round ten-native-pane qualification.

measured_bundle_scope: Immutable local release bundle before final generated icon packaging and source EOF normalization; not a measurement of the current published binary.
unavailable_breakdown: Resident native GUI RSS was measured separately. Helper, tmux and per-pane monitor role labels were not persisted, so no further process-role attribution is established.
